summary: Verified v1.2.2 icon bug-fix in tudo_mais_facil.rbz. Static-file inspection (zipfile + regex) plus SU2026 compliance regression + ruby -c syntax check. 14/14 pytest tests pass. All 10 PNG icon files present with valid PNG signatures and > 500 bytes. main.rb toolbar block resolves icons via File.dirname(__FILE__) (no PLUGIN_ROOT usage in code, only in a comment). Each of the 4 commands (cmd_local, cmd_cloud, cmd_lastro, cmd_modulo) sets both small_icon (_24.png) and large_icon (.png) to a distinct icon family. PLUGIN_VERSION correctly bumped to 1.2.2. Ruby syntax OK for tudo_mais_facil.rb and all files under tudo_mais_facil/ (verified with ruby 3.1.2 -c).
critical_code_review_comments: Ruby 2.2.4 compatibility test (test_ruby_22_backward_compatibility) still passes across all .rb files in the .rbz.
PLUGIN_ROOT is still defined in tudo_mais_facil.rb and used for the SketchupExtension.new path — that is correct and intentional (as noted by the main agent).
Visual quality of the 4 icons cannot be judged programmatically; user must verify in SketchUp 2026 PT-BR after reinstall.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two static-inspection regression suites now cover the .rbz: test_rbz_su2026_compliance.py (structure + Ruby 2.2 backcompat) and test_rbz_v1_2_2_icons.py (version bump, 10 PNGs present + valid, main.rb toolbar uses File.dirname(__FILE__), each cmd has distinct small+large icon). Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_rbz_v1_2_2_icons.py backend/tests/test_rbz_su2026_compliance.py -v
rca of the issue: Root cause was correctly identified by main agent: TudoMaisFacil::PLUGIN_ROOT is defined in tudo_mais_facil.rb via File.dirname(__FILE__), which resolves to the Plugins/ directory (parent of the entry-point .rb), not the tudo_mais_facil/ subfolder where icons live. Previous main.rb built icon paths as File.join(PLUGIN_ROOT, 'ui', 'icon.png') → Plugins/ui/icon.png (nonexistent) → SketchUp fell back to the broken-file icon. Fix in v1.2.2: main.rb toolbar section uses ui_dir = File.join(File.dirname(__FILE__), 'ui') where __FILE__ is tudo_mais_facil/main.rb, so paths correctly resolve to Plugins/tudo_mais_facil/ui/*.png. Verified by regex-scan of the toolbar block in the archived main.rb.
